segments.ja368:2.1: Na socanāya paridevanāya, atthova labbho [attho ca labbhā (sī. syā.), atthodha labbhā (a. ni.5.48)] api appakopi;
segments.ja368:2.3: Socantamenaṃ dukhitaṃ viditvā, paccatthikā attamanā bhavanti.
segments.ja368:3.1: Yato ca kho paṇḍito āpadāsu, na vedhatī atthavinicchayaññū;
segments.ja368:3.3: Paccatthikāssa [paccatthikā te (ka.)] dukhitā bhavanti, disvā mukhaṃ avikāraṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.ja368:4.1: Jappena mantena subhāsitena, anuppadānena paveṇiyā vā;
segments.ja368:4.3: Yathā yathā yattha labhetha atthaṃ, tathā tathā tattha parakkameyya.
segments.ja368:5.1: Yato ca jāneyya alabbhaneyyo, mayā va [mayā vā (syā. ka.)] aññena vā esa attho;
segments.ja368:5.3: Asocamāno adhivāsayeyya, kammaṃ daḷhaṃ kinti karomi dānīti.
